initial_cash: Exact frozen first raw open times 1000; zero residual cash, hypothetical acquisition at quoted open
costs: Gross accounting, entry fees/slippage/withholding/insurance/terminal liquidation excluded; not investor net proceeds or executable performance
valuation: Units times last observed RAW close + settled cash + unpaid gross distributions. Preserve all calendar days; separately identify market dates and stale market quotes.
dividend_policy: Before-opening holders receive per-physical-unit entitlement at ex-date. Initial purchase on ex-date has no entitlement. Receivable transfers to cash only on stated payment calendar date, including non-market days; never reinvested.
split_policy: Confirmed 4-for-1 on 2025-06-18. Only unit count changes; do not multiply cash or existing receivables. Carry raw quote valuation over known 2025-06-11 through 2025-06-17 halt only.
source_policy: Prefer exact official TWSE tables for 2023/2024/2025 and split announcement. Save/backup/readback SHA/CRC/manifest before ledger. No third-party numeric substitution. At most one issuer bulk-history fallback route if incomplete; retain failures.
source_gate: Exactly two positive nonduplicated 0050 dividends in each complete year, valid ex/payment order; all raw-price causal-factor changes match six ex-dates plus split. Any unknown action, quote gap, date/amount ambiguity fails closed.
historical_pit: Realized gross accounting reconstruction from current official historical records; not original announcement-time versions, future features, live signals or proof of actual brokerage cash credits.
comparison: Show frozen official-reference adjusted quote change alongside physical gross cash/receivable NAV; different reinvestment/cash conventions, no attribution to skill and no rewriting prior studies.
acceptance: Source and action coverage complete; independent entitlement/paid-to-date arithmetic and daily cash+receivable identity agree <=1e-8 TWD. Missing source stays gap, no favorable return gate.
